question: Halogen 0.20.0 (gfx1151 iGPU) vs Strata 0.1.57 (R9700 gfx1201) on the SAME weights: unsloth UD-IQ4_XS (pre-v3.1, 3-shard)
method: Same-file engine A/B via BYO-GGUF path. Halogen: podman 0.20.0, HALOGEN_CHECKPOINT=UD-IQ4_XS (rev 766911a6b736, the 3-shard build Halogen measures), HALOGEN_KV_POOL_POSITIONS=262144, defaults (prompt cache, MTP on, greedy). Strata: 0.1.57 existing install, prod-parity flags (262144/k8v4/spec 4/0.5/prefill 16384/kv-resident 32768/ple-io ram), port 8082. Both engines cold-loaded sequentially with prod stopped, prod restored after. Probe: gen_probe.py warmup + 5x256-token greedy decode medians + ~101K cold prefill + 20-req soak, unique-nonce text. NOTE: '47k' label is a misnomer - words 28000 yielded ~101.7K tokens; identical both sides so comparison holds.

prod_reference_strata_ud_iq2_xs.note: different quant (UD-IQ2_XS), shown as context only

notes: unsloth re-quantized repo to UD v3.1 on 2026-11-04 (new GGUF tensor type 42) - Halogen 0.20.0 refuses it (unknown tensor type 42); Strata accepts it as UD-IQ4_XS-v31. Halogen's documented IQ4_XS numbers are on the pre-v3.1 3-shard file (rev 766911a6b736), which both engines accept, so the A/B pinned that revision for a clean same-file comparison.

Halogen GGUF path costs ~28% decode vs its own v2 checkpoint (8-bit trunk heavier per token, per Halogen docs) - published best-case is ~54-94 t/s on 128GB Strix Halo with its own 4.16bpw checkpoint; ours 50.1 on BYO-GGUF.
Halogen found 33.5 GiB RAM held at start = orphaned Strata expert arena in /dev/shm; leg scripts now delete it lsof-gated after stopping flashnext.
Verdict: Strata stays prod engine for decode (dominant cost). Halogen wins prefill by 10%, but Strata's R9700 VRAM expert cache outperforms the iGPU's LPDDR5 host-RAM path for decode.
One-model-at-a-time gate respected; gemma (co-tenant on iGPU) stopped for Halogen leg, both restored after.
recommendation: Keep Strata 0.1.57 + UD-IQ2_XS as prod (decode 98 t/s reference still best). IQ4_XS is not a prod swap candidate on this box - Strata-IQ4XS decodes 80.9 (below IQ2XS 98) and Halogen-IQ4XS decodes 50.1.
